scope: Create the first new OPT-003 prospective prediction wave: freeze one pre-outcome model from the current effective training corpus, materialize and deterministically scan exactly three outcome-blind product repositories, persist compatible predictions and timestamps, and stop before packet selection, source rendering, human review, or labels.

training_cutoff.digest_contract: SHA-256 of canonical sorted tuples (evaluation family, rule id, finding fingerprint, actionable, source, created_at) after family-distinct reconciliation
training_cutoff.immutability: The wave model may use only this digest-frozen corpus. Any later assessment or label requires a new wave and cannot enter this model.

frozen_sources.selection_basis: Previously frozen but never activated OPT-002 reserve; deployed self-hostable Rails/Vue customer-support product with account, inbox, agent, team, conversation, and integration boundaries.
Active deployable TypeScript collaborative bookmark and web-archive product with users, collections, member permissions, sharing, uploads, API keys, and external capture boundaries.
Active deployable Python/Django document-management product with sensitive document ingestion, users, permissions, export, OCR, storage, and integration boundaries.

selection_exclusions: security findings, advisories, issues, pull requests, scanner output, finding counts, scores, ranks, labels, outcomes, target paths, or answer keys
archived products, forks, tutorials, benchmarks, deliberately vulnerable applications, and any existing acquisition/evaluation family
execution_sequence: Recompute and verify the exact training-corpus digest and initial store identity before any write or network transfer.
Train and persist exactly one wave model before materializing any source; freeze its complete model, feature-schema, calibration, training-cutoff, and training-label identities.
Resolve each remote only to its exact frozen commit, materialize it under a new repository identity, and record immutable source digests.
Run only deterministic scanners and deployment canaries; preserve scanner versions, applicability, status, failures, target counts, and raw artifact digests.
Extract features and persist scores for eligible findings under the one frozen wave model.
Persist a prediction-wave result containing exact score timestamps and eligible outcome-blind inventory counts, then stop.
stop_conditions: Any training label, store, protocol, source commit, family identity, or selected repository differs from the frozen value.
The model is not fully trained and frozen before source materialization, scanning, feature extraction, or scoring.
A source cannot be resolved byte-exactly, a required scanner is unhealthy, or scoring identity differs across repositories.
Any score, finding, security outcome, or target path influences source selection or repository order.

Any provider call, unsupported network host, packet selection, evidence rendering, human review, assessment, label, rescore, tuning, recalibration, threshold selection, or production-policy change is attempted.

not_authorized: tuning, recalibration, threshold selection, or policy change
result_boundary.next_gate: A result PR must prove source/model/training/score identities and zero outcomes before a separate outcome-blind packet-selection receipt may be proposed.

authorization.required_statement: I authorize OPT-003 prospective prediction wave one described by opt-003-wave-1-prediction-receipt-2026-08-10.json, limited to one model trained before acquisition from the digest-frozen 122-label effective corpus, exact-commit materialization and deterministic scanning of only chatwoot/chatwoot, linkwarden/linkwarden, and paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx, compatible feature extraction and prediction persistence, and one prediction-wave result, with ceilings of three repositories, one model-training run, 180 minutes per repository, 600 minutes total, 15 GiB new data, GitHub-only network access, and exactly zero provider calls, tokens, cost, human reviews, assessments, or labels. Packet selection, candidate disclosure for review, source rendering, a second wave, rescoring, tuning, recalibration, threshold selection, and production-policy changes remain excluded.
